answer_1.quote: We generate up to 300 tokens per prompt and, to improve the robustness of our analyses, generate 3 samples for every prompt… We prompt the language models with each sentence from a pair … to obtain two sets of generations from the language model.
answer_1.outputs: generated continuations (up to 300 tokens) per prompt

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity to quantify whether there are differences in the overall distribution of language generated… We use a BERT sentiment classifier fine‑tuned on the SST‑2 dataset to analyse the sentiment of generations… We also use the PERSPECTIVE API to score generations for potentially sensitive topics.
